pages.name: Layer of Silt
pages.description: The outline of a bird can be made out beneath a thin layer of silt.

options.description: Brush away the silt with your palm
Lift the edge of a loose tile

pages.name: Complete Picture
pages.description: A mosaic of a flying owl is revealed on the floor. The pattern remains in place.

scenePatch.description: The cleaned mosaic of a flying owl is visible beneath the clear water.

pages.name: Detached Fragment
pages.description: The tile comes easily out of the old mortar. Part of a golden wing remains on it.

scenePatch.description: One small fragment is missing from the mosaic.
